mapper.sql: (SELECT pc2.car_image_url FROM platform_car pc2 LEFT JOIN cz_platform_priority pp ON pp.platform_name = pc2.platform_name WHERE pc2.car_id = cm.car_id AND pc2.car_image_url IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IFNULL(pc2.car_image_url,'')) != '' ORDER BY pp.priority ASC LIMIT 1)
mapper.select:
SELECT cm.car_id AS carId, (SELECT MAKER_NAME FROM CZ_MAKER Z WHERE CM.MAKER_CODE = Z.MAKER_CODE) MAKER_NAME, (SELECT MODEL_NAME FROM CZ_MODEL Z WHERE CM.MODEL_CODE = Z.MODEL_CODE) MODEL_NAME, (SELECT TRIM_NAME FROM CZ_TRIM Z WHERE CM.TRIM_CODE = Z.TRIM_CODE) TRIM_NAME, cm.year AS year, cm.mileage AS km, MIN(pc.price) AS priceMin, MAX(pc.price) AS priceMax, MAX(pc.updated_at) AS priceUpdatedAt, AS representativeImageUrl, cm.MODEL_CODE, COALESCE(MAX(pc.fuel), cm.fuel) AS fuel, COALESCE(MAX(pc.region), cm.region) AS region FROM car_master cm LEFT JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id
GROUP BY cm.car_id
ORDER BY priceMin ASC ORDER BY km ASC ORDER BY year DESC ORDER BY priceUpdatedAt DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cm.car_id) FROM car_master cm LEFT JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id

SELECT cm.car_id AS carId, pc.maker_name, pc.model_group_name, pc.model_name, pc.trim_name, cm.year, cm.mileage, cm.displacement, COALESCE(pc.fuel, cm.fuel) AS fuel, COALESCE(pc.transmission, cm.transmission) AS transmission, COALESCE(pc.color, cm.color) AS color, COALESCE(pc.body_type, cm.body_type) AS body_type, COALESCE(pc.region, cm.region) AS region, pc.platform_car_id AS platformCarId, pc.platform_name, pc.price, pc.status, pc.pc_url, pc.m_url, DATE_FORMAT(pc.last_seen_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastSeenDate, pc.car_image_url AS representativeImageUrl FROM car_master cm INNER JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id LEFT JOIN cz_platform_priority pp ON pp.platform_name = pc.platform_name WHERE cm.car_id = #{carId} ORDER BY pc.price ASC, COALESCE(pp.priority, 999) ASC
SELECT pc_url AS pcUrl, m_url AS mUrl FROM platform_car WHERE car_id = #{carId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT car_id AS carId, model_code AS modelCode FROM car_master
car_id IN #{id}

SELECT pc2.car_image_url FROM platform_car pc2 LEFT JOIN cz_platform_priority pp ON pp.platform_name = pc2.platform_name WHERE pc2.car_id = #{carId} AND pc2.car_image_url IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IFNULL(pc2.car_image_url,'')) != '' ORDER BY COALESCE(pp.priority, 999) ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT pc.platform_car_id FROM platform_car pc WHERE pc.car_id = #{carId} ORDER BY pc.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT checked_at AS ts, price FROM car_price_history WHERE platform_car_id = #{platformCarId} ORDER BY checked_at ASC
SELECT image_url AS imageUrl, is_main AS isMain, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM cz_model_image WHERE model_code = #{modelCode} ORDER BY is_main DESC, sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT MAKER_CODE AS code, MAKER_NAME AS name FROM CZ_MAKER ORDER BY name
SELECT model_group_code AS code, model_group_name AS name FROM cz_model_group WHERE MAKER_CODE = #{makerCode} ORDER BY name

SELECT cm.car_id AS carId, cm.maker_code AS makerCode, cm.model_group_code AS modelGroupCode, cm.model_code AS modelCode, cm.trim_code AS trimCode, cm.grade_code AS gradeCode, (SELECT MAKER_NAME FROM CZ_MAKER Z WHERE CM.MAKER_CODE = Z.MAKER_CODE) AS makerName, (SELECT MODEL_NAME FROM CZ_MODEL Z WHERE CM.MODEL_CODE = Z.MODEL_CODE) AS modelName, (SELECT TRIM_NAME FROM CZ_TRIM Z WHERE CM.TRIM_CODE = Z.TRIM_CODE) AS trimName, cm.year AS year, cm.mileage AS km, MIN(pc.price) AS priceMin, MAX(pc.price) AS priceMax, MAX(pc.updated_at) AS priceUpdatedAt, COALESCE(MAX(pc.fuel), cm.fuel) AS fuel, COALESCE(MAX(pc.transmission), cm.transmission) AS transmission, COALESCE(MAX(pc.body_type), cm.body_type) AS bodyType, COALESCE(MAX(pc.region), cm.region) AS region, cm.car_no AS carNo, AS representativeImageUrl FROM car_master cm LEFT JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id WHERE cm.adv_status = 'ONSALE' GROUP BY cm.car_id, cm.maker_code, cm.model_group_code, cm.model_code, cm.trim_code, cm.grade_code, cm.year, cm.mileage, cm.fuel, cm.transmission, cm.body_type, cm.region, cm.car_no ORDER BY cm.car_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT cm.car_id AS carId, cm.maker_code AS makerCode, cm.model_group_code AS modelGroupCode, cm.model_code AS modelCode, cm.trim_code AS trimCode, cm.grade_code AS gradeCode, m.maker_name AS makerName, mo.model_name AS modelName, t.trim_name AS trimName, cm.year AS year, cm.mileage AS km, MIN(pc.price) AS priceMin, MAX(pc.price) AS priceMax, MAX(pc.updated_at) AS priceUpdatedAt, COALESCE(MAX(pc.fuel), cm.fuel) AS fuel, COALESCE(MAX(pc.transmission), cm.transmission) AS transmission, COALESCE(MAX(pc.body_type), cm.body_type) AS bodyType, COALESCE(MAX(pc.region), cm.region) AS region, cm.car_no AS carNo, MAX(img.representativeImageUrl) AS representativeImageUrl FROM car_master cm LEFT JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id LEFT JOIN cz_maker m ON m.maker_code = cm.maker_code LEFT JOIN cz_model mo ON mo.maker_code = cm.maker_code AND mo.model_group_code = cm.model_group_code AND mo.model_code = cm.model_code LEFT JOIN cz_trim t ON t.maker_code = cm.maker_code AND t.model_group_code = cm.model_group_code AND t.model_code = cm.model_code AND t.trim_code = cm.trim_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT car_id, car_image_url AS representativeImageUrl FROM ( SELECT pc2.car_id, pc2.car_image_url, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pc2.car_id ORDER BY COALESCE(pp.priority, 999) ASC) rn FROM platform_car pc2 LEFT JOIN cz_platform_priority pp ON pp.platform_name = pc2.platform_name WHERE pc2.car_image_url IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(IFNULL(pc2.car_image_url,'')) != '' ) x WHERE rn = 1 ) img ON img.car_id = cm.car_id WHERE cm.adv_status = 'ONSALE' AND cm.car_id > #{lastCarId} GROUP BY cm.car_id, cm.maker_code, cm.model_group_code, cm.model_code, cm.trim_code, cm.grade_code, cm.year, cm.mileage, cm.fuel, cm.transmission, cm.body_type, cm.region, cm.car_no, m.maker_name, mo.model_name, t.trim_name ORDER BY cm.car_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT cm.car_id AS carId, cm.maker_code AS makerCode, cm.model_group_code AS modelGroupCode, cm.model_code AS modelCode, cm.trim_code AS trimCode, cm.grade_code AS gradeCode, (SELECT MAKER_NAME FROM CZ_MAKER Z WHERE CM.MAKER_CODE = Z.MAKER_CODE) AS makerName, (SELECT MODEL_NAME FROM CZ_MODEL Z WHERE CM.MODEL_CODE = Z.MODEL_CODE) AS modelName, (SELECT TRIM_NAME FROM CZ_TRIM Z WHERE CM.TRIM_CODE = Z.TRIM_CODE) AS trimName, cm.year AS year, cm.mileage AS km, MIN(pc.price) AS priceMin, MAX(pc.price) AS priceMax, MAX(pc.updated_at) AS priceUpdatedAt, COALESCE(MAX(pc.fuel), cm.fuel) AS fuel, COALESCE(MAX(pc.transmission), cm.transmission) AS transmission, COALESCE(MAX(pc.body_type), cm.body_type) AS bodyType, COALESCE(MAX(pc.region), cm.region) AS region, cm.car_no AS carNo, AS representativeImageUrl FROM car_master cm LEFT JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id WHERE cm.adv_status = 'ONSALE' AND cm.updated_at >= #{updatedSince} GROUP BY cm.car_id, cm.maker_code, cm.model_group_code, cm.model_code, cm.trim_code, cm.grade_code, cm.year, cm.mileage, cm.fuel, cm.transmission, cm.body_type, cm.region, cm.car_no ORDER BY cm.updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT cm.car_id AS carId, cm.maker_code AS makerCode, cm.model_group_code AS modelGroupCode, cm.model_code AS modelCode, cm.trim_code AS trimCode, cm.grade_code AS gradeCode, (SELECT MAKER_NAME FROM CZ_MAKER Z WHERE CM.MAKER_CODE = Z.MAKER_CODE) AS makerName, (SELECT MODEL_NAME FROM CZ_MODEL Z WHERE CM.MODEL_CODE = Z.MODEL_CODE) AS modelName, (SELECT TRIM_NAME FROM CZ_TRIM Z WHERE CM.TRIM_CODE = Z.TRIM_CODE) AS trimName, cm.year AS year, cm.mileage AS km, MIN(pc.price) AS priceMin, MAX(pc.price) AS priceMax, MAX(pc.updated_at) AS priceUpdatedAt, COALESCE(MAX(pc.fuel), cm.fuel) AS fuel, COALESCE(MAX(pc.transmission), cm.transmission) AS transmission, COALESCE(MAX(pc.body_type), cm.body_type) AS bodyType, COALESCE(MAX(pc.region), cm.region) AS region, cm.car_no AS carNo, AS representativeImageUrl FROM car_master cm LEFT JOIN platform_car pc ON pc.car_id = cm.car_id WHERE cm.car_id = #{carId} GROUP BY cm.car_id, cm.maker_code, cm.model_group_code, cm.model_code, cm.trim_code, cm.grade_code, cm.year, cm.mileage, cm.fuel, cm.transmission, cm.body_type, cm.region, cm.car_no LIMIT 1
